# Arabic AI Atlas

> The Arabic AI ecosystem as a map, a list, and a skill your agent can install. 271 entries, generated 2026-10-04.

## Models

- [XTTS-v2](https://huggingface.co/coqui/XTTS-v2): Coqui's multilingual voice cloning, Arabic support, 6s cloning
- [whisper-large-v3-turbo](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo): 4x faster Whisper, Arabic support, MIT license
- [openai/whisper-large-v3](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-large-v3): Supports Arabic among many languages
- [wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-arabic](https://huggingface.co/jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-arabic): Fine-tuned on Common Voice & Arabic Speech Corpus
- [AraBERTv02](https://huggingface.co/aubmindlab/bert-base-arabertv02): Improved tokenization (135M params, 12M+ downloads)
- [Phi-4](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/phi-4): Multilingual with Arabic, compact & efficient
- [Llama 3.3](https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct): Strong Arabic performance
- [MMS-1b-all](https://huggingface.co/facebook/mms-1b-all): Meta's Massively Multilingual Speech, ASR for 1100+ languages
- [SeamlessM4T v2](https://huggingface.co/facebook/seamless-m4t-v2-large): Meta's all-in-one ASR + translation, ~100 languages inc. Arabic
- [Voxtral Mini](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Voxtral-Mini-3B-2507): Mistral's speech model, 3B, Arabic support, Apache 2.0
- [opus-mt-ar-en](https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-ar-en): Translation AR→EN - Helsinki-NLP (12.4M+ downloads)
- [MARBERTv2](https://huggingface.co/UBC-NLP/MARBERTv2): Updated with improved dialectal coverage
- [opus-mt-en-ar](https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-ar): Translation EN→AR - Helsinki-NLP (3.5M+ downloads)
- [Whisper Quran](https://huggingface.co/tarteel-ai/whisper-base-ar-quran): Whisper fine-tuned for Quranic recitation recognition
- [GATE-AraBert-v1](https://huggingface.co/Omartificial-Intelligence-Space/GATE-AraBert-v1): SOTA on MTEB Arabic STS
- [asafaya/bert-base-arabic](https://huggingface.co/asafaya/bert-base-arabic): BERT-based Arabic embeddings
- [Fanar-1-9B](https://huggingface.co/QCRI/Fanar-1-9B-Instruct): Arabic-English LLM
- [Falcon Arabic](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon3-7B-Instruct): First Arabic model in Falcon series, top of OALL
- [ALLaM](https://huggingface.co/ALLaM-AI/ALLaM-7B-Instruct-preview): Saudi's sovereign model, enterprise-focused
- [Arabic-Triplet-Matryoshka-V2](https://huggingface.co/Omartificial-Intelligence-Space/Arabic-Triplet-Matryoshka-V2): Matryoshka representation
- [facebook/mms-tts-ara](https://huggingface.co/facebook/mms-tts-ara): Facebook's Massively Multilingual Speech
- [AraT5](https://huggingface.co/UBC-NLP/AraT5-base): T5 for Arabic summarization, translation, paraphrasing
- [Ar-stablelm-2-chat](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stablelm-2-1_6b-chat): Small Arabic chat model
- [AraELECTRA](https://huggingface.co/aubmindlab/araelectra-base-discriminator): ELECTRA for Arabic
- [Cohere Command-A](https://huggingface.co/CohereForAI/c4ai-command-a-03-2025): Optimized for RAG

## Datasets

- [SARD](https://huggingface.co/datasets/riotu-lab/SARD): Synthetic Arabic OCR dataset for recognition training
- [Mixed Arabic Datasets (MAD)](https://huggingface.co/datasets/M-A-D/Mixed-Arabic-Datasets-Repo): Community-driven diverse Arabic texts
- [101 Billion Arabic Words](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ClusterlabAi/101_billion_arabic_words_dataset): Massive Arabic web corpus
- [arabic-img2md](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MohamedRashad/arabic-img2md): 15K PDF pages paired with Markdown
- [ArVoice](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MBZUAI/ArVoice): Multi-speaker MSA corpus, 83h, 11 voices, diacritized
- [ArabicText-Large](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Jr23xd23/ArabicText-Large): 743K articles for LLM training
- [ClArTTS](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MBZUAI/ClArTTS): Classical Arabic TTS corpus by MBZUAI
- [Egyptian Arabic ASR Clean](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MAdel121/arabic-egy-cleaned): ~72 hours of Egyptian Arabic speech
- [Arabic-OpenHermes-2.5](https://huggingface.co/datasets/2A2I/Arabic-OpenHermes-2.5): Arabic OpenHermes instruction dataset
- [CIDAR](https://huggingface.co/datasets/arbml/CIDAR): Culturally relevant instruction dataset (10K pairs)
- [Arabic-VLM-Full-Pearl](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MohamedRashad/Arabic-VLM-Full-Pearl): 309K multimodal examples for VLM training
- [Arabic Speech Corpus](https://huggingface.co/datasets/halabi2016/arabic_speech_corpus): Nawar Halabi's Levantine Arabic TTS corpus (CC-BY-4.0)
- [Shifaa Medical](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ahmed-Selem/Shifaa_Arabic_Medical_Consultations): Arabic medical consultation dataset
- [ArabicWeb24](https://huggingface.co/datasets/lightonai/ArabicWeb24): 39B+ tokens of high-quality Arabic web content
- [KFUPM Arabic AI Text Detection](https://huggingface.co/datasets/KFUPM-JRCAI/arabic-generated-abstracts): Machine-generated Arabic text across multiple LLMs
- [Arabic Tweets](https://huggingface.co/datasets/pain/Arabic-Tweets): 41GB+ of Arabic tweets (~4B words)
- [Arabic-English Code-Switching](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MohamedRashad/arabic-english-code-switching): Code-switching speech from YouTube
- [SADA](https://huggingface.co/datasets/m6011/sada2022): Saudi Audio Dataset: 668h from 57 TV shows, multi-dialect (SDAIA)
- [Arabic POS Dialect](https://huggingface.co/datasets/QCRI/arabic_pos_dialect): POS tagging in Arabic dialects
- [Arabic Billion Words](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MohamedRashad/arabic-billion-words): Abu El-Khair corpus: 5M+ articles, 1.5B+ words
- [Arabic_Function_Calling](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HeshamHaroon/Arabic_Function_Calling): First Arabic function calling dataset (50K+ samples)
- [BAREC Corpus](https://huggingface.co/datasets/CAMeL-Lab/BAREC-Corpus-v1.0): Arabic Readability Assessment
- [Rasaif](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ImruQays/Rasaif-Classical-Arabic-English-Parallel-texts): Classical Arabic-English parallel texts (24 books)
- [QADI](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Abdelrahman-Rezk/Arabic_Dialect_Identification): Twitter-based multi-class dialect classification
- [Shifaa Mental Health](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ahmed-Selem/Shifaa_Arabic_Mental_Health_Consultations): Arabic mental health consultations

## Tools & Benchmarks

- [ArabicMMLU](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MBZUAI/ArabicMMLU): Multi-task language understanding from school exams
- [ArabicRAGB](https://huggingface.co/datasets/HeshamHaroon/ArabicRAGB): Arabic RAG Benchmark (multi-dialect)
- [SILMA RAGQA Benchmark](https://huggingface.co/datasets/silma-ai/silma-rag-qa-benchmark-v1.0): Evaluates Arabic/English LMs in Extractive QA tasks
- [ACVA](https://huggingface.co/datasets/FreedomIntelligence/ACVA-Arabic-Cultural-Value-Alignment): Arabic Cultural Value Alignment (8000+ questions, 58 areas)
- [Arabic Broad Benchmark (ABB)](https://huggingface.co/datasets/silma-ai/arabic-broad-benchmark): Comprehensive evaluation tool for Arabic LLMs
- [ALUE](https://www.alue.org/): Arabic Language Understanding Evaluation benchmark
- [Arabic Broad Leaderboard (ABL)](https://huggingface.co/spaces/silma-ai/Arabic-LLM-Broad-Leaderboard): NextGen evaluation for Arabic LLMs by SILMA AI
- [arabic-stop-words](https://github.com/mohataher/arabic-stop-words): Largest list of Arabic stop words
- [arabic_vocalizer](https://github.com/nipponjo/arabic_vocalizer): Deep-learning diacritization (ONNX format)
- [arabicprocess](https://pypi.org/project/arabicprocess/): Python library for Arabic preprocessing
- [AraDiCE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.11404): Benchmarks for dialectal and cultural capabilities of LLMs
- [BALSAM](https://benchmarks.ksaa.gov.sa/): Benchmark of Arabic Language AI Systems and Models
- [camel_tools](https://github.com/CAMeL-Lab/camel_tools): Suite of Arabic NLP tools (morphology, POS, NER, etc.)
- [CATT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.03236): Character-based Tashkeel Transformer, SOTA results
- [EasyOCR](https://github.com/JaidedAI/EasyOCR): Ready-to-use OCR with Arabic support (80+ languages)
- [Farasa](https://farasa.qcri.org/): Fast and accurate Arabic text processing toolkit
- [Fine-Tashkeel](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/372616004): Fine-tuned ByT5, 40% WER reduction
- [GATmath and GATLc](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0329129): Benchmarks from Saudi GAT exams
- [KITAB-Bench](https://huggingface.co/datasets/MBZUAI/KITAB-Bench): Arabic OCR benchmark: 8,809 samples, 9 domains, 36 sub-domains (MBZUAI)
- [MADAMIRA](https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/research/faculty-labs-and-projects/computational-approaches-to-modeling-language-lab/research/morphological-analysis-of-arabic.html): Morphological analysis, diacritization, POS tagging
- [Maha](https://github.com/TRoboto/Maha): Text processing library for Arabic text
- [Mishkal](https://github.com/linuxscout/mishkal): Rule-based diacritizer with dictionary lookups
- [MTEB Arabic Leaderboard](https://huggingface.co/spaces/mteb/leaderboard): Massive Text Embedding Benchmark for Arabic
- [NADI 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.04910): NADI 2024 - Fifth Nuanced Arabic Dialect Identification
- [NADI 2025](https://nadi.dlnlp.ai/2025/): NADI 2025 - Multidialectal Arabic Speech Processing (8-way dialect + ASR)

## Organizations

- [King Saud University](https://huggingface.co/faisalq/SaudiBERT): SaudiBERT, Saudi dialect corpora (STMC, SFC)
- [Ain Shams University](https://cis.asu.edu.eg/): Arabic NLP, sentiment analysis, NER research
- [Arabic.AI (Tarjama)](https://www.tarjama.com/): Arabic-first autonomous AI - Pronoia Arabic LLM, Agentic AI platform
- [Arabot](https://arabot.io/): Conversational AI for Arabic - Arabic NLP chatbot engine
- [ARBML](https://github.com/ARBML): Democratizing Arabic NLP - masader, klaam, tkseem
- [AUB MIND Lab](https://github.com/aub-mind): Foundational Arabic NLP models - AraBERT, AraGPT2, AraELECTRA
- [CAMeL Lab (NYU Abu Dhabi)](https://camel-lab.com/): CAMeLBERT, camel_tools, morphological analysis
- [CAMeL Lab, NYUAD](https://github.com/CAMeL-Lab): Arabic NLP tools and models - CAMeLBERT, camel_tools
- [Cohere](https://cohere.com/): Multilingual LLMs - Command R Arabic, RAG optimization
- [Convertedin](https://www.converted.in/): AI marketing automation - Arabic/English e-commerce personalization, $3M funded
- [Crowd Analyzer](https://crowdanalyzer.com/): Arabic social media monitoring - Arabic NLP analytics, sentiment analysis, media monitoring
- [DXwand](https://dxwand.com/): Generative AI for Arabic business - ORXTRA platform, Arabic dialect chatbots, 20+ LLM support
- [Elm](https://elm.sa/en/): Digital transformation, gov AI (PIF-backed) - Nuha Arabic LLM, legal AI assistant, gov platform
- [Elves](https://www.elves.com/): Conversational commerce - Arabic AI-assisted concierge, human-in-the-loop ML
- [FreedomIntelligence](https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence): Arabic LLMs and alignment - AceGPT, Arabic cultural datasets
- [Future Look ITC (FLITC)](https://flitc.ai/): Arabic-native AI solutions, venture studio - LABEAH, Smart Hire, Rayee Media, Nabadat
- [G42](https://www.g42.ai/): AI holding company, Arabic LLMs - Jais LLM, enterprise AI solutions
- [G42 / Inception AI](https://www.g42.ai/): Arabic-centric LLMs - Jais LLM family
- [Hazen.ai](https://www.hazen.ai/): AI traffic safety & computer vision - Deep learning road safety, seatbelt/phone detection
- [Helsinki-NLP](https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP): Machine translation models - OPUS-MT Arabic translation models
- [Hudhud AI](https://hudhud.ai/): Arabic conversational AI (no-code SaaS) - Saudi-accent chatbots, Arabic-first customer engagement
- [HUMAIN](https://www.humain.com/): PIF-backed full-stack AI company - ALLaM 34B, HUMAIN Chat, 8PB Arabic training data
- [HUMAIN (Saudi PIF)](https://www.humain.com/): Full-stack AI company - ALLaM 34B, HUMAIN Chat, AI factories
- [Inception AI](https://www.g42.ai/): Arabic-centric foundation models - Jais model family (with Cerebras)
- [Intella](https://intella.ai/): Arabic speech AI intelligence - Arabic STT across 25+ dialects (95.7% accuracy), Ziila digital human

## Agent Skills

- [arabic-bidi-engineering](https://github.com/MosaabGalmod/arabic-bidi-engineering): Agent skill for correct Arabic RTL/BiDi in chat, terminal and documents
- [awesome-arabic-claude-skills](https://github.com/EngDawood/awesome-arabic-claude-skills): Curated library of open-source Arabic skills for Claude Code and agents
- [karem-arabic-presentation](https://github.com/karem505/karem-arabic-presentation): Claude Code skill for Arabic/English bilingual RTL HTML presentations
- [quran-mcp](https://github.com/quran/quran-mcp): MCP server giving AI assistants grounded access to Quran text
- [rtl-skill](https://github.com/mhamedmohammed92-arch/rtl-skill): Teaches coding agents to build correct RTL UIs with a checker
- [turath-mcp](https://github.com/opin22/turath-mcp): MCP server for turath.io: classical Arabic and Islamic books
